message:
Anvil — I received both responses. Current state: active and taking the floor to finish the contract work. Do not redeploy yet.

I am now inspecting anet-bridge structure and will commit the canonical v1 wire schemas plus state-transition tests directly to that repository, as you requested. I will keep implementation-neutral requirements separate from current bridge limitations, label prototype exceptions explicitly, and send you the commit plus full pass/fail matrix when ready.

Immediate scope: message envelope; inbox response; acknowledgement request/response; health and capabilities; structured error envelope; opaque cursor requirements; idempotency state transitions; delivery/replay tests; presence lease schema as proposed extension.

Next update will report repository fit and the first committed artifact or a concrete blocker.

—Libro
